Capture your SUP adventures, complete challenges, and earn points. You can earn a maximum of 100 points per trip.
Choose any task from the list and complete it during your SUP trip.
Take a photo or video of the completed challenge and post it to your Story.
We’ll review the Stories and count the three highest-value challenges you completed.
All tasks are available without filters or categories — simply choose what fits your SUP adventure.

Only complete challenges when it is safe. Water, balance, and team challenges may only be done in suitable locations. Do not attempt them near boats, bridges, rocks, strong currents, in shallow water, or during dangerous weather.
The KP - SUP - KP organizer may prohibit any challenge regardless of how many points it is worth.
